messages:
Ivy: opened PR to modernize the hello-bonsai quickstart: auth var, minimal deploy, and a short migration note for SDK v6. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1043 — need a quick docs review and link check.
Noah: taking a look. first glance: node snippet uses REDWOOD_TOKEN; pls switch to REDWOOD_API_KEY for consistency. also the Dockerfile example doesn't expose the app port.
Kira: saw that too. the deployment page references /deploy/#run-locally but the anchor was renamed to run-locally-dev last week — link-checker will flag it.
Ivy: thanks, i'll update env var and Dockerfile. can we standardize wording around "API key" vs "token" in the migration note?
Noah: use "API key (REDWOOD_API_KEY)" everywhere — fewer support questions. i'll submit a tiny commit to replace token mentions.
wayne-bot: link-checker: 1 broken anchor in quickstarts/hello-bonsai.md -> ./deploy.md#run-locally (404).
docs-bot: lint: code fence language mismatch in README (js vs ts), recommend typescript for TS samples.
Kira: i've adjusted the deploy header to keep the old anchor and added an alias so existing links don't break. pushed to the branch.
Ivy: pushed Dockerfile fix: added EXPOSE 8080 and updated docker run example to `docker run -p 8080:8080 hello-bonsai`. also added a migration note header at top.
Noah: updated Node snippet to use client.generate and REDWOOD_API_KEY. also added short note about updated default timeout in SDK v6.
docs-bot: CI: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-1043--docs.redwood-ai.com/quickstarts/hello-bonsai — link check passed after latest changes.
Ivy: preview looks good. i'm going to merge once CI stays green and then tag a docs patch.
Kira: i'll follow up with a tiny redirect PR for any external blog links that still point to the old anchor.
Noah: quick follow-up: added a one-liner in the sample explaining outputs are non-deterministic unless seed is set to avoid confusion.
Ivy: perfect. merging in ~15m. thanks all :heart:

---

Snippet (Node) from PR:
```ts
import { Redwood } from "@redwood/inference";
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: "bonsai-mini", prompt: "draw a simple bonsai ASCII" });
console.log(res.text);
```

Action items: Ivy - merge + tag release; Kira - redirect PR for external anchors; Noah - squash migration note into changelog entry.
